checks.notes: All fan-out points correctly send to both mainWindow and studioWindow with proper null and isDestroyed() guards. Verified in: cdp-fingerprint.ts (pushDriftStatus, L135-142), cdp-fanout.ts (engine inject failure L710-717, health report L919-920), bundle-ipc.ts (FILE_IMPORTED L145-146), agent-engine-service.ts (notifyBackgroundTaskFailure L683-692), main-context.ts (notifyPersistFailure L206-213, sendStatusChanged L158-169), theme-hot-reload.ts (pushToRenderers L148-160). Pattern is consistent: optional chaining + isDestroyed() check before webContents.send.

useAppController.ts L314-322 correctly subscribes to onPersistFailureWarning IPC channel. On receipt: (1) increments persistFailures in diagnosticsStore via incrementPersistFailures(failureCount), (2) calls notificationStore.fail() with a descriptive Chinese message including the failure count. The fail() method in notificationStore.ts (L142-159) renders a destructive toast. The complete chain is: main-context.notifyPersistFailure() -> webContents.send(PERSIST_FAILURE_WARNING) -> preload onPersistFailureWarning subscription -> useAppController effect -> notificationStore.fail().

THEME_BACKGROUND_TASK_FAILURE IPC channel is fully wired. Producer: theme-apply-flow.ts L698-722 uses Promise.allSettled(backgroundTasks).then() to filter rejected results and calls deps.notifyBackgroundTaskFailure({agentId, themeId, message}). Transport: agent-engine-service.ts L683-692 fans out to both windows via IpcChannel.THEME_BACKGROUND_TASK_FAILURE. Bridge: preload.ts L533-537 exposes onThemeBackgroundTaskFailure via subscribe<{agent, themeId, message}>(). Consumer: useAppController.ts L299-306 subscribes and calls notificationStore.fail() with agent name and message. Channel defined in ipc-channels.ts L339. All links verified and consistent.

issues: useAppController.test.ts uses SSR rendering which does not fire useEffect hooks — IPC subscription side effects (onPersistFailureWarning, onThemeBackgroundTaskFailure, onThemeDriftStatus, onThemeEngineInjectFailure) are NOT exercised at runtime. This is a known documented limitation in the test file header.
No dedicated test file for cdp-fingerprint.ts pushDriftStatus fan-out (covered indirectly via cdp-fanout.test.ts pattern consistency).
No dedicated test file for bundle-ipc.ts BUNDLE_OPEN_FILE fan-out (fan-out logic is a single-liner using the same pattern as other verified sites).
checks.notes: Test coverage is comprehensive for core logic paths. cdp-fanout.test.ts (1120 lines) covers: epoch guards, engine/legacy injection, watchdog skip/inject, multi-page scenarios, epoch abort, health check, rendererHints unification, pooled sessions, hardeningRemove, connectWithRetry. theme-apply-flow.test.ts (355 lines) covers: background task failure detection (rejected filtering, null on success, single/multi failure, string-throw fallback, empty list, null reason), fast path (cached port, cold apply, requires-restart), baseline seeding + light probe. agent-engine-service-persist-visibility.test.ts covers: null after success, failure capture + persist_failed event, signal clearing. useAppController.test.ts covers: return object shape (all key fields), action reference types, store value propagation.

summary: All four requirements pass verification. REQ-I-1001 (dual-window fan-out) is consistently implemented across 7 files with uniform null/isDestroyed() guards. REQ-I-1011 (persist failure toast) has a complete IPC chain from main-process threshold detection to renderer destructive toast. REQ-I-1003 (background task failure notification) has end-to-end coverage from Promise.allSettled detection through IPC fan-out to renderer toast. REQ-I-1008/1009 (test coverage) is strong for core logic with known SSR limitation for IPC subscription effects in useAppController. No security issues identified — all IPC channels use centralized enum, all window references are null-checked and isDestroyed()-guarded.
